text:
sam: Noticing an uptick in leads that arrive in HS with owner unset. Looks tied to enrichment timeouts ~30s. Can we avoid "no-route" dropping them?

*tess*: I pulled router logs: when enrich hangs, router eventually marks no-route. No DLQ. Sales logged 4 missed touches.

deploy-bot: rollout: enrichment-worker v3.2.1 at 02:10 UTC (no rollback).

rahul: Quick mitigation idea: implement short debounce + overflow assignment. If enrichment pending > 15s assign to overflow_pool but mark metadata.handoff_mode = "overflow_debounce" so workflows treat differently.

ivy: +1. Add hs_pending_enrich_ts and hs_handoff_mode mappings so bizops can filter. Also add a flag hs_no_sequence when overflow_debounce to prevent nurture emails.

paul: Another thought: instead of immediate assign, attempt a 2-step debounce: wait 6s, check again, if still pending try assign to overflow with a reconcile ticket queued for 90s to let enrichment finish and claim if better. That reduces flip-flop.

sam: I like the reconcile ticket approach. Action items: rahul to prototype overflow_debounce (feature flag marketing.debounce_overflow), ivy to add HS mappings and suppression, paul to create reconcile scheduler, tess to run a 24h audit and post count.

rahul: I'll open a small PR tonight with unit tests for race cases. Feature flag default OFF.

ivy: HS mapping proposed:
metadata.enrich_started -> hs_pending_enrich_ts
metadata.handoff_mode -> hs_handoff_mode
metadata.reconcile_id -> hs_reconcile_id
hs_no_sequence -> boolean suppression field

paul: SQL audit stub (will run and post):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
AND metadata.enrich_started IS NOT NULL;
```

*tess*: I'll notify SDR ops to expect small volume in overflow_pool if we enable canary.

deploy-bot: Incident created: #marketing-enrich-debounce-3071112223.

sam: If we can ship flag + HS mapping tomorrow morning we can run a weekend canary and monitor fallback_rate and reconcile_success. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
